recommendation: Library folders, explicit cancellable indexing and Files navigation, ending in the existing Browser/queue/audio service. This closes the fixture-only library acquisition gap.

architecture.authority: Existing Worker producer source-generation/version publication remains the SQLite-to-UI authority. A scan is a checked request tied to source generation and roots revision; completion after replacement/cancel/close cannot publish. Imports commit SQL before publishing Version; same-generation prepared metadata needs a new policy if scans edit existing tracks, because present generation-only leases assume additive imports.
architecture.execution: Reuse the existing library worker, bounded command/result lanes and typed existing Question for directory/page reads. Incremental discovery/index work must poll controls between files and coalesce progress, preserving browse responsiveness without an extra scanner worker forest. No scan or page completion authorizes playback.
architecture.data: Canonical PathBuf file identity and file metadata observations feed typed indexed metadata, then transactional album/artist/track/link updates. Preserve track/playlist occurrence IDs across unchanged rescans and relocations where proved. Avoid parallel page entity/cache models.
architecture.ui: Typed LibraryFolders component with SourcePath edits, Scan/Stop/Rescan and missing-root Keep/Delete decisions; real Files directory route and explicit file/folder Play actions. Public Win tests and original Registry service/provider remain the testing surface.
architecture.settings: Persist only library roots/scan policy needed for this domain with atomic replacement/corrupt-file failure visibility. Full appearance/services/playback settings editor remains a separate domain.
architecture.not_claimed: OS watching/storage notifications, artwork thumbnail cache/UI, full metadata/provider/codec coverage and platform media/scrobbling stay explicitly absent unless separately implemented and qualified.

fixtures: Temporary persistent SQLite library, restart and corrupt settings/scan-record controls
Real tagged WAV/FLAC/MP3 fixtures with Unicode names, multiple artists/discs, duration, malformed and missing files
Nested roots, overlap/symlink cycle, unavailable/remounted root, rename and modified tags, canceled/replaced scan
Exact old buffered Prepared/context result against index commit; stable queue occurrence and clone Stop/Pause/Seek
Headless public sources/questions plus actual native Registry folder selection/scan/Files/play/stop/disconnect/normal close
